faq.a1: It's the song without your instrument. Pick a track, mute the guitar (or drums, bass, vocals…) and play over the rest of the band — as if they were rehearsing with you.
faq.q2: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a2: No. Everything runs in the browser, on desktop or phone. Open a song and hit play.
faq.q3: Can I use my own songs?
faq.a3: Yes. Upload the file and the platform automatically splits it into independent stems — drums, bass, guitar, keys and vocals — so you can build any mix you want.
faq.a4: Chords and lyrics are generated automatically and synced to the audio, so they're a very good starting point — but not perfect. Anyone can fix them, and the correction is saved for everyone who comes next.
faq.q5: How does it work for my band?
faq.a5: Create the band, invite the members and each one picks the instrument they play. When you open the same song, each person hears everything but their own instrument — and rehearsal and show setlists are shared across the group.
faq.a6: We're in beta and not selling plans yet: the catalog is free to explore, no credit card. The prices above are our launch estimate and may still change.

howItWorks.metaDescription: From the catalog to AI stem separation, from rehearsal to the stage: here's how backingtrack.store works.
howItWorks.title: From catalog to stage, <accent>in four steps</accent>.
howItWorks.subtitle: Backing tracks, AI instrument separation and band tools, all in one player built for people who play — not for people who only listen.
howItWorks.videoFallback: Your browser doesn't support video playback.
howItWorks.step1Text: Browse the catalog of backing tracks with synced chords, or upload your own recording and let AI split the instruments for you.
howItWorks.step2Text: Adjust speed and key (pitch shift) and loop a tricky section, with the chord chart scrolling in real time alongside the audio.
howItWorks.step3Text: On paid plans, solo or mute each stem — drums, bass, guitar and more — to focus only on your part.
howItWorks.step4Title: Take it to rehearsal and the stage
howItWorks.step4Text: Build setlists with your band, fix the chord chart together, and use Performance mode to play distraction-free during the show.
howItWorks.f1Text: Ready-made backing tracks, with the chord chart advancing in real time along with the music — no counting bars.
howItWorks.f2Text: Adjustable speed, pitch shift (change the key without changing the tempo) and A-B looping to repeat the part you're working on.
howItWorks.f3Text: Upload your own audio and our AI tools split the recording into per-instrument stems, and also help detect chords, key and tempo.
howItWorks.f4Text: Once a song is processed it becomes available to other paying subscribers — avoiding reprocessing and lowering the cost for everyone.
howItWorks.f5Text: Record your own performance over the backing track (overdub) straight from the browser. Private by default — you decide whether to share it with the band or publish it.
howItWorks.f6Text: Create a band, invite members, build shared setlists and let the community suggest chord fixes before the show.
howItWorks.disclaimer: AI separation is an evolving technology and can be imprecise — treat the result as a study reference, and count on the community to fix the chart when needed. Only upload audio you own or are authorised to use; we honour copyright holder notices under our <link>Terms of Use</link>.
howItWorks.ctaText: The catalog is open during the beta — no account required to explore.

about.title: Connecting musicians through music.
about.metaDescription: The mission, the values and the team behind backingtrack.store.
about.intro: backingtrack.store started from a simple problem: practising or performing with a good instrumental bed and a synced chord chart always meant juggling a YouTube video, a chord chart from one site, a tuner from another, and hours separating parts by ear. We brought all of that together — plus the AI that does the instrument separation for you.
about.whatP1: We're a music practice platform: a catalog of backing tracks with chord charts synced in real time, a professional player with speed, key and section-loop controls, and AI tools that split any audio you upload into per-instrument tracks (stems) — drums, bass, guitar and more.
about.whatP2: For bands, we offer shared setlists, community chord corrections and a Performance Mode built for rehearsal and stage.
about.v1Text: Every feature comes from a real need of someone who practises, rehearses and performs — not of someone who only listens.
about.v2Text: No chord chart is perfect the first time. We let the community of musicians suggest and validate corrections.
about.v3Text: We run a catalog shared between subscribers, but we take rights holder notices seriously — with a clear notice-and-takedown policy.
about.v4Text: What you record stays private by default. We never use your content to train AI models without explicit authorisation.
about.operatorText: backingtrack.store is operated by L2techs, based in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. The full privacy policy, terms of use and copyright handling are detailed on the site's legal pages.
